text:
maria: quick thread — dashboards show ~12% drop in inference_event counts for 2026-03-12 00:00-10:00 UTC.
jonah: saw that too. looks like collector v2 started dropping on 03-12 01:23 UTC. any logs?
sumi: logs show kafka consumer lag spikes and retry storms. i can pull partition offsets and consumer group state.
alex: if it's consumer lag, we need backfill. short question: do we re-run the spark recompute dag or try streaming re-ingest?
maria: short-term = recompute aggregates for affected window to fix dashboards. long-term = fix consumer + hedged reads.
kevin: agreed. also watch quotas — large backfills can blow through reserved capacity and throttle customers. we need gating.
jonah: spark dag name is recompute_telemetry_agg, it accepts --start/--end. concern: is it idempotent? last time partial parquet files broke things.
sumi: exactly. partial output is the blocker. we should write to tmp/ and atomic mv to final path, or include a cleanup step.
alex: i can extend the internal "recompute" API to accept a clean=true toggle so airflow does teardown first. debate: api vs cli-only?
maria: product/console UX: we want a "recompute window" modal that shows estimated cost, ETA, and quota risk before triggering.
kevin: on quotas: implement per-org concurrency limits and a global backfill rate cap. also require approval for >X TB.
jonah: suggestion: preflight check that detects partials, computes bytes/tokens to be recomputed, and returns a cost estimate. preview before confirm.
sumi: i have a prototype preflight script that checks s3, consumer offsets, and partial outputs. example commands:
```
# check partials
aws s3 ls s3://telemetry/agg/day=2026-03-12/ | grep part- | wc -l
# trigger recompute (airflow)
airflow dags trigger recompute_telemetry_agg --conf '{"start":"2026-03-12T00:00","end":"2026-03-12T10:00","clean":true}'
```
maria: can we surface backfill activity in Console: job status, estimated cost, and links to logs? product liked that.
alex: plan: add POST /internal/recompute body {start,end,clean,org_id,concurrency}. will return job_id and require service token + rate limit.
jonah: please add audit log entries + job id in response so we can tie to dashboards. telemetry-bot should post progress to #eng-platform.
telemetry-bot: scheduled job 1782345800 started: recompute job_id=recompute-20260312-01 (estimated 45m, cleaning=true)
sumi: running preflight now. will report partial counts and estimated bytes in 10m. :hourglass:
